title: PromotionRecord.v1
description: The record that moves the active pointer from a prior version to a promoted candidate. The lossless law's promotion gate: promotion is a pointer move, never a delete — the prior version (prior_version_id) and every rejected candidate (rejected_candidate_ids) are KEPT, and a rollback_target_id is REQUIRED so the move is always reversible. A PromotionRecord without a rollback_target is invalid (required field + check enforces). Carries the InformationRetentionReport id that proved the candidate safe_to_promote and the receipt warranting the promotion.

artifact_key.description: the logical key whose current pointer moved (versions share a key)

promoted_artifact_id.description: the candidate now pointed to as current

prior_version_id.description: the version the pointer moved away from; KEPT, never deleted

rejected_candidate_ids.description: candidates that lost; preserved with lineage to the winner; MUST be present even if empty

rollback_target_id.description: REQUIRED — the version rollback reverts the pointer to; without it the promotion is not lossless and is rejected

retention_report_id.description: the InformationRetentionReport that proved the candidate safe_to_promote

side_by_side_run_id.description: the run where baseline + candidate ran on the same source snapshot before promotion
